title: 懸掛式單軌轉轍系統~Suspended-monorail switch systems
focus: 懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據~Load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches
summary: 本課聚焦懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據。從可動構件力行程帳建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把致動推力與獨立保持與動作回授的事件次序連成可驗證的介面，最後以維修恢復與服務條件整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches. Start with force-travel work of moving members to define physical or information boundaries, connect actuation thrust and independent holding with event ordering in actuator feedback as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through maintenance recovery and service conditions. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1901 年烏帕塔爾懸掛式鐵路開始服務旅客。；2010 年機械風險評估方法的該版標準發布。；2023 年機械安全控制設計方法更新版發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩及中止偏斜與失訊案例連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 1901: The Wuppertal suspension railway began carrying passengers. 2010: This edition of machinery risk-assessment guidance was published. 2023: An updated machinery safety-control design edition was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through switch-linkage lever arm and torque and interrupted, skewed and missing-feedback cases. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究可動構件力行程帳。原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。敏感度只改 F=4500 至 4950 N，輸出變為 913.846 J；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：準靜態剛性連桿力矩，不包含實際懸掛式轉轍構造、動態衝擊或額定設計。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。比較往返曲線的差異，找出摩擦或對位偏差可能出現的行程位置。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate force-travel work of moving members. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements. For sensitivity, change only F=4500 to 4950 N; the output becomes 913.846 J. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate switch-linkage lever arm and torque: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Quasistatic rigid-link torque, excluding actual suspended-switch construction, impact dynamics and rated design. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. Compare forward and reverse curves to locate possible friction or alignment effects. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 可動構件力行程帳~Force-travel work of moving members
units.title: 可動構件力行程帳~Force-travel work of moving members
units.mechanism: 用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。比較往返曲線的差異，找出摩擦或對位偏差可能出現的行程位置。致動器輸入能量必須支應負載作功與摩擦損失。相同行程不代表相同負載，潤滑、對位與溫度會改變力的分布；只看總電流峰值可能忽略行程中某一位置的卡滯，需把力與位移配對。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。~Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. Compare forward and reverse curves to locate possible friction or alignment effects. Actuator input energy must cover load work and frictional loss. Equal travel does not imply equal loading because lubrication, alignment and temperature change force distribution. A single current peak can miss binding at a particular position, so force should be paired with displacement. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements.
units.verify: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。以「可動構件力行程帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions. For force-travel work of moving members, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。回到「可動構件力行程帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. Trace the input chain for force-travel work of moving members. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉~Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking.
units.practice: 只把作用力 F 從 4500 改成 4950 N（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 830.769 變為 913.846 J。先說明「可動構件力行程帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only applied force F from 4500 to 4950 N (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 830.769 to 913.846 J. Explain the causal direction for force-travel work of moving members, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩~Switch-linkage lever arm and torque
units.title: 轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩~Switch-linkage lever arm and torque
units.mechanism: 轉轍構件的力臂必須垂直於作用力，不能把連桿全長直接代入。比較不同幾何位置的機械利益，明確保留簡化定力臂未描述的死點行為。懸掛式轉轍梁的驅動力矩由致動力與垂直有效力臂相乘，連桿角度會讓有效力臂隨行程改變。馬達輸出足夠不代表遠端梁位已到達，彈性變形、齒隙與摩擦均會改變傳力；機械保持及位置確認必須有獨立證據，不能由一次成功轉動推論。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：準靜態剛性連桿力矩，不包含實際懸掛式轉轍構造、動態衝擊或額定設計。~Use the perpendicular lever arm rather than the entire linkage length. Compare mechanical advantage across positions and retain dead-centre behaviour omitted by a constant-arm approximation. Drive torque for a suspended switch beam is actuator force times perpendicular effective lever arm, which changes with linkage angle. Adequate motor output does not establish that the remote beam has arrived. Compliance, backlash and friction affect force transfer; mechanical retention and position confirmation need independent evidence rather than inference from one successful movement. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Quasistatic rigid-link torque, excluding actual suspended-switch construction, impact dynamics and rated design.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：準靜態剛性連桿力矩，不包含實際懸掛式轉轍構造、動態衝擊或額定設計。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Quasistatic rigid-link torque, excluding actual suspended-switch construction, impact dynamics and rated design.
units.verify: 用縮尺連桿同時量測力與垂直力臂，在不同角度比較力矩，再以獨立位移計核對遠端梁的位置。以「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure force and perpendicular lever arm on a scale linkage at several angles, then independently check remote beam position with a displacement sensor. For switch-linkage lever arm and torque, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 連桿接近不利幾何時所需力會提高，齒隙又可能使馬達角度改變卻沒有相應梁位移。回到「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Unfavourable linkage geometry raises required force, while backlash can allow motor-angle change without corresponding beam displacement. Trace the input chain for switch-linkage lever arm and torque. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 馬達角度已達目標就能保證懸掛式轉轍梁定位完成~The target motor angle guarantees completed positioning of a suspended switch beam.
units.practice: 只把力臂 r 從 0.08 改成 0.088 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 144 變為 158.4 N*m。先說明「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only lever arm r from 0.08 to 0.088 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 144 to 158.4 N*m. Explain the causal direction for switch-linkage lever arm and torque, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 多致動點位置差~Position mismatch across actuators
units.title: 多致動點位置差~Position mismatch across actuators
units.mechanism: 同一可動梁的多個致動點若不同步，微小速度差可能累積成扭斜。以共同時基追蹤位置差和負載轉移，不把平均行程完成當成各點同時到位。耦合致動器的小速度差會隨動作時間累積成行程差，使連桿扭轉或局部阻力增加。位置回授能限制累積，卻仍需共同座標和獨立零點檢查；兩個馬達瞬間轉速相同只代表該時刻差值不再增加，並不能消除先前留下的位置偏移。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。~Small speed differences among actuators on one moving beam can accumulate into skew. Track position differences and load transfer on a common clock rather than treating mean completed travel as simultaneous arrival. A small speed difference between coupled actuators accumulates into travel mismatch, twisting linkages or increasing local resistance. Position feedback can limit accumulation but requires a common coordinate and independent zero checks. Equal instantaneous motor speeds only stop further growth at that instant; they do not remove the position offset already accumulated. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：致動端一速度 v1=0.012 m/s；致動端二速度 v2=0.0115 m/s；動作時間 t=20 s。公式 y=(v1-v2)*t*1000，代入得 y=10 mm。邊界：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first actuator speed v1=0.012 m/s; second actuator speed v2=0.0115 m/s; motion time t=20 s. Formula y=(v1-v2)*t*1000 gives y=10 mm. Boundary: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立位移計同時量測兩個連接點，對照編碼器零點與連桿幾何，再比較低負載及偏載時的誤差斜率。以「多致動點位置差」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure both connection points simultaneously with independent displacement sensors, compare encoder zeros and linkage geometry, then compare drift slopes at low and uneven load. For position mismatch across actuators, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 某端摩擦增加會造成位移差斜率改變，共同零點錯誤則可能讓兩端回授一致卻偏離機構中線。回到「多致動點位置差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Extra friction at one end changes the mismatch slope, whereas a shared zero error can make feedback agree while the linkage is displaced from its reference. Trace the input chain for position mismatch across actuators. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零~Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero.
units.practice: 只把動作時間 t 從 20 改成 22 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 10 變為 11 mm。先說明「多致動點位置差」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only motion time t from 20 to 22 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 10 to 11 mm. Explain the causal direction for position mismatch across actuators, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 致動推力與獨立保持~Actuation thrust and independent holding
units.title: 致動推力與獨立保持~Actuation thrust and independent holding
units.mechanism: 液壓壓力乘有效面積只估算推力，不能單獨證明載車路徑已能承載。將定位、保持和位置確認分開列成介面，使用隔離教具觀察摩擦與背壓。液壓推力由壓力乘有效活塞面積決定，回程側面積與背壓可能不同。壓力達標並不保證位移同步，漏油、氣泡和摩擦會改變動作；安全承載還需獨立機械保持機制與設備規定，不能只依賴壓力表。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。~Pressure times effective area estimates thrust but does not establish a load-bearing train path. Separate positioning, holding and confirmation interfaces and inspect friction and back pressure on an isolated rig. Hydraulic force follows pressure times effective piston area, with different return-side area and back pressure possible. Target pressure does not guarantee synchronized movement because leakage, air and friction affect motion. Safe support also requires specified holding mechanisms rather than dependence on a pressure gauge alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：油壓 p=12 MPa；活塞面積 A=0.008 m2；力傳遞效率 eta=0.9 1。公式 y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000，代入得 y=86.4 kN。邊界：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: hydraulic pressure p=12 MPa; piston area A=0.008 m2; force-transfer efficiency eta=0.9 1. Formula y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000 gives y=86.4 kN. Boundary: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立力感測器核對壓力推算，並記錄停留時的位移漂移與油溫變化。以「致動推力與獨立保持」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare pressure-derived force with an independent load cell and record displacement drift and oil temperature during holding. For actuation thrust and independent holding, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 內洩漏可造成保持位置下降但壓力讀值短時正常，空氣混入則可能使動作變軟並延遲。回到「致動推力與獨立保持」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Internal leakage can cause sag despite temporarily normal pressure, while entrained air makes motion compliant and delayed. Trace the input chain for actuation thrust and independent holding. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位~A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
units.practice: 只把油壓 p 從 12 改成 13.2 MPa（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 86.4 變為 95.04 kN。先說明「致動推力與獨立保持」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only hydraulic pressure p from 12 to 13.2 MPa (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 86.4 to 95.04 kN. Explain the causal direction for actuation thrust and independent holding, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 承載位置與支點反力~Load position and support reactions
units.title: 承載位置與支點反力~Load position and support reactions
units.mechanism: 在兩支承教學模型中移動偏心載重，觀察反力如何重新分配而總和不變。將可動構件自重和假想車重分列，避免以幾何中心代替實際重心。兩支承反力由力與力矩平衡同時決定。重心偏向一側時，該側反力增加而另一側減少，總和仍不變；平均反力看似充足不能掩蓋單側限制，支承接觸若脫離還會改變原先的邊界條件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。~Move an eccentric load in a two-support teaching model and observe reaction redistribution at constant total load. Separate moving-member weight from hypothetical vehicle weight and distinguish geometric centre from centre of gravity. Two support reactions follow both force and moment equilibrium. Moving the centre of gravity toward one support raises that reaction while reducing the other without changing the total. Adequate mean reaction cannot hide a local limit, and loss of contact changes the assumed boundary conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。公式 y=W*(0.5+e/L)，代入得 y=120 kN。邊界：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m. units.anchor: 位置鎖定與路徑狀態~Position, locking and route states
units.title: 位置鎖定與路徑狀態~Position, locking and route states
units.mechanism: 到位、鎖定與路徑允許是不同命題，任何單一訊號都不能自動代表整個介面完成。以抽象狀態圖保存未知與不一致情況，不照抄代表工程的專有控制邏輯。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Position reached, locking established and route permission are different propositions. Preserve unknown and inconsistent combinations in an abstract graph without reproducing a reference installation's proprietary logic. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.

Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for position, locking and route states. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

units.anchor: 動作回授的事件次序~Event ordering in actuator feedback
units.title: 動作回授的事件次序~Event ordering in actuator feedback
units.mechanism: 把動作命令、機械反應和位置回授分成獨立時間點，檢查軟體顯示是否早於實體確認。將感測更新和傳輸等待列帳，範例不作現場動作延時設定。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Separate command, mechanical response and position feedback to check whether a display precedes physical confirmation. Account for sensor updates and transmission waiting without adopting example delays as field settings. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Trace the input chain for event ordering in actuator feedback. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

units.anchor: 雙確認鏈共同原因~Common causes in duplicated confirmation
units.title: 雙確認鏈共同原因~Common causes in duplicated confirmation
units.mechanism: 兩個位置通道若共用安裝支架或電源，仍可能同時產生相同錯誤。先列共享條件再比較獨立失效，讓備援論證保留機械與電氣的共同來源。兩支路都失效才失去功能的架構可降低獨立故障貢獻，卻不能消除共同原因。共同電源、相同軟體缺陷或同處淹水會同時影響兩支路；因此增加硬體數量不能取代分離、異質性與失效偵測的證據。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。~Position channels sharing a bracket or supply may produce the same error simultaneously. Identify common mechanical and electrical conditions before combining independent failures in a redundancy argument. A function lost only when both branches fail can reduce independent contributions but cannot eliminate common causes. Shared power, identical software defects or flooding at one location can affect both branches. More hardware does not replace evidence for separation, diversity and fault detection. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。公式 y=common+(1-common)*p*p，代入得 y=0.000104 1。邊界：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1. units.anchor: 中止偏斜與失訊案例~Interrupted, skewed and missing-feedback cases
units.title: 中止偏斜與失訊案例~Interrupted, skewed and missing-feedback cases
units.mechanism: 把正常切換、行程中止和確認失聯分成不同試驗，不以多次成功動作代表全部狀態。用離線重播追蹤每項需求，保留安全停止後的復原邊界。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Treat normal switching, interrupted travel and lost confirmation as distinct tests rather than counting repeated successful moves as full coverage. Trace requirements through offline replay and retain recovery boundaries after safe withdrawal. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

For interrupted, skewed and missing-feedback cases, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

units.anchor: 維修恢復與服務條件~Maintenance recovery and service conditions
units.title: 維修恢復與服務條件~Maintenance recovery and service conditions
units.mechanism: 區分機構修復、確認鏈恢復和旅客服務恢復，三者時間點不必相同。以維修履歷比較短停與長停，避免可用度數字掩蓋仍未完成的承載或鎖定證據。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Distinguish mechanism repair, confirmation recovery and passenger-service restoration because their timestamps may differ. Compare short and long outages without letting availability conceal incomplete load-path or locking evidence. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.verify: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「維修恢復與服務條件」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For maintenance recovery and service conditions, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for maintenance recovery and service conditions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1.
